CustomField.description: Project 790, escalation/escape-route requirement: true when the Opportunity Owner is a member of the "AMS Team - Approval Exempt" public group. Flow-maintained by Opportunity_Sync_Proposal_Approval_Exemption (kept as a plain field, not a formula, since formulas cannot query GroupMember). Read by Block_Closed_Won_Without_Proposal, Block_Send_to_OM_Without_Approval, and Quote_Submit_For_Approval to skip the approval requirement entirely for exempt owners.
CustomField.label: Exempt From Proposal Approval
